email.body1:
James, saw Pactum raised a $54M Series C led by Insight Partners and added 25-plus Global 2000 customers.

Scaling enterprise that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Pactum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
James, quick follow-up for Pactum.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pactum needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
James, last bit of proof for Pactum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pactum's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Pactum either way.
